The index

2125 effects

Every named psychological effect in the counted record, from FORRT and Retested-reviewed papers. Filter by what happened when people tried again. Effects with at least one replication verdict come first, most cited at the top.

Only effects with at least one replication linked are listed. 177 more are named in FORRT's records without one; they are listed apart.
